User.title: User
User.description: Information about a registered player on CodeArena, including historical statistics and customized preferences.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user matches their email base id.

username.description: The custom display name chosen by the user.

avatar.description: URL to the user's avatar image.

level.description: Current player level computed from XP score.

totalScore.description: Total compilation and algorithmic XP accumulated.

challengesDone.description: Total number of challenges evaluated on CodeArena.

wins.description: Total number of dynamic duel match victories.

losses.description: Total number of duel match losses.

proPassUnlocked.description: Determines whether premium ligue status has been activated.

provider.description: The login provider type (e.g. google, github).

ChallengeSubmission.title: ChallengeSubmission
ChallengeSubmission.description: The history and structured evaluation output score from a challenge solution attempt.

userEmail.description: The email of the player submitting the solution.

challengeId.description: Unique code for the source challenge card.

score.description: Overall score on a scale of 0-100.

globalFeedback.description: The general feedback in French from the Gemini AI.

Duel.title: Duel
Duel.description: Dynamic online competitive play arena lobby status.

roomId.description: The human-readable Room ID code used for joining.

status.description: Lobbies can be waiting, ready, coding or finished.

winnerEmail.description: Email address of the winning player if finished.

users/{userId}.description: User account collection identified by document email context.

challenges/{challengeId}.description: History of challenge attempts and automated Gemini evaluation marks.
